entities.name: Sree Padmanabhadasa Sree Swathi Thirunal Rama Varma
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sri Swathi Thirunal Rama Varma III was the Maharaja of the Kingdom of Travancore. He was a musician and composer who wrote over 400 classical compositions in both Carnatic and Hindustani style.
